Het zoekveld leegmaken Sluit de zoekbalk Annuleren Dutch healthcare Voorlezen Print E-mail QR Code On Thuisarts.nl you can find reliable information about the healthcare system in the Netherlands. Thuisarts.nl is an independent website (in Dutch) with health information. Thuisarts.nl is developed and maintained by the Dutch College of General Practitioners. The information is written in a comprehensible and understandable way, adapted for use by the general public. This information has been integrated from the former website GPinfo.nl, which was also part of Thuisarts.nl. Wat is je situatie?
